extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and prospective editors who encounter a missing article title and may want to create or locate it
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for users who find a Wikipedia title with no article: how to verify whether the topic already exists, account/confirmation requirements to create pages, and procedural alternatives (drafts, requests, redirects).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation required to create new articles
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create the page immediately because you lack an account or autoconfirmed status, use alternative workflows (see below). Being logged in/autoconfirmed is a prerequisite for creating a new article directly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use article wizard / submit a draft / request a new article as alternatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not autoconfirmed or prefer guided creation/review, follow the article wizard to create a draft and have it reviewed, or use the request-a-page process so other editors can create the article for you.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles and incoming links before creating
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for the title (e.g., "Subverted expectation") in existing articles and look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify whether the topic already exists under a different title, is discussed within another article, or already has incoming links; creating a duplicate article should be avoided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check recent-creation delays and use purge if necessary
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, allow time for propagation or use the purge function to refresh. This helps avoid accidental duplication of a just-created page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account for title capitalization and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Try alternate capitalizations/punctuation and, when appropriate, create a redirect from common variants to the canonical article title instead of making duplicate pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: If a page was deleted, consult the deletion log
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before recreating a deleted page, review the deletion log and any deletion discussions to understand why it was removed and whether recreating it is appropriate or requires community discussion.
